# Romantic Orientation Value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RomanticOrientationValue>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A pattern of romantic attraction — a VALUE pointed at by [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md), never a subclass. Kept separate from sexual orientation (split-attraction). Open: a fresh individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) when none is seeded.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for romantic-attraction patterns, kept deliberately separate from the sexual value space — reference a seed (heteroromantic, homoromantic, biromantic, panromantic, aromantic, demiromantic, queerromantic, questioning) or mint a fresh individual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-value subclasses or a closed enum (it is an open individual vocabulary), and avoid co-typing a romantic value as a sexual one — the two value spaces are disjoint so asexual ≠ aromantic stays expressible.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded individual from [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md), or mint a fresh [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) with an [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and an SSSOM alignment row when the orientation is not seeded; never promote a value to a subclass.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:romanticBiromantic`](../individuals/gmeow-romanticBiromantic.md) a [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "biromantic"@en.
